item.title: Documentation
item.description:
Workflow

The CHIPS database is a key component of a broader workflow integrating web-oriented technologies, including an API, a Python dashboard, and an R package hosted on GitHub.

item.title: State of interest
item.description: CHIPS was developped to fill a gap on ancient iron metallurgy data reusability (Why CHIPS DB?). This need, and the practical ways to address it, are a piece of the history of archaeological sciences (A short history of the DB).
